definition_IGU: sum over tuning runs of population_size (Ps=n*pop_mult) times generations G; exact for RED, bounded for AMBER because only the selected promoted configuration is archived, not all five promoted configurations
definition_problem_size_weighted_proxy: IGU multiplied by n*m for each target as a rough objective-evaluation arithmetic proxy; not CPU/wall time
warning: Proxy only. It accounts for n, m, G and population multiplier but not implementation/vectorization/hardware effects; do not present as measured elapsed-time reduction.
